name: midpoint-val
what: the search's three midpoint models on R's 100 puzzles served as NODE-cross-val's checkpoints and NODE-cross-test's references of her models were (two H100s a model, four at a time), so all three read on one footing: her recipe on dagger-u4-lag1's own labels (u4lab-17k), on the same moments labelled again her way (u4relab-17k), and the run's own trainer once on all its labels (scratch-u4). Their adapters reach the bucket once each node's model is copied under ~/runs/rt/cross-u4/models (the operator plan's search item); run it on an 8x H100 then
